basic_profile.bio: I'm a 42-year-old music enthusiast and synthwave aficionado living in Portland, Oregon. I work as an audio engineer and spend my days mixing tracks and occasionally performing at local retro music events. Outside of work, I enjoy collecting vintage synthesizers and have a special passion for 80s music. I'm married with two kids who are just as much into music as I am. I usually hop on Reddit in the evenings after dinner, around 8 PM, when I unwinding with a glass of whiskey. I'm not a fan of overly commercial or generic pop music, and I try to avoid political subreddits as they can be a bit too intense for my taste.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in audio production and over a decade of experience in the music industry, I've honed my skills in sound design and mixing. My expertise is largely self-taught, built through countless hours of experimentation and learning from fellow musicians and producers.
